Rello is a grocery delivery app. It delivers in fifteen minutes from small

WHY MO VE 1 COMES FIRS T

Do not start with "the law requires…" or "under GDPR…". Ask: which authority, 
using which document, with which powers? If you skip this, you may answer the 
wrong letter.

KEY WORD T ODAY: INST RUME NT

An instrument is the document where a duty is written: a law, a permit, a 
certificate — or a document the company wrote itself, like a privacy notice. Every 
duty has an instrument. Every instrument has an owner and a date.

AU T HO R IT I ES, NO T " T HE L A W"

A company does not answer to "the law". It answers to specific 
authorities. Each has its own instrument and its own powers.

FROM YOUR READING · FOUR KINDS O F AUT HORIT Y

Permitting authorities give permission with conditions. They can change, suspend or 
cancel it.

Competition agencies investigate market behaviour and can order changes.

Labour enforcers can be inspectors, prosecutors, or both.

Data regulators audit how data is used and can order it to stop. Each asks a different 
question. An answer sent to the wrong one is useless.

MOVE 2
Find the duty   What your reading gives you
AI OFF
Slide 8a

T WO KI N DS O F IN ST RU M EN T

Two kinds of document create duties: documents written to the 
company, and documents the company wrote itself.

FROM YOUR READING

Written to the company (authorizations): permits, licences, certificates. The activity is legal

only if the company follows the conditions. Written by the company (conduct documents):

terms, privacy notices, codes of conduct, rulebooks. These are promises, and regulators and

courts hold the company to them. About half of real cases come from this second kind.
pages.chinese:
MOVE 2 找到责任 你的阅读会给你带来什么 AI 不可用 Slide 8a 两种工具 两种文档创建职责：将文档写入 公司，以及公司自己编写的文件。从你的阅读中 写给公司的（授权）：许可证、执照、证书。活动合法 仅当公司遵守条件时。

公司撰写（行为文件）： 条款、隐私声明、行为准则、规则手册。这些都是承诺，监管机构和 法院将公司归他们所有。大约一半的真实案例来自第二种。
pages.note: 两类文件都可能让企业背上义务：外部规则和企业自己的文件。好比餐厅要守卫生法，也要兑现菜单写出的承诺。

FROM YOUR READING · WHE N A P RODUCT HURTS S OME ONE: THRE E LEGAL ROUT ES

Privity (the oldest rule): only the buyer can sue.

Negligence: anyone who is hurt can sue, but must prove the maker was careless. That is 
hard, because the evidence is inside the maker's factory.

Strict liability (Justice Traynor, California): she proves two things only — the product was 
defective, and the defect caused the harm.

She does not need to prove carelessness.

There are three kinds of defect: manufacturing, design, warning.

Slide 12c

What "with conditions" means

Not "yes, but…". It means a concrete plan: 
the fix, with a date · the check, with a named 
owner · the wording agreed before signing · 
the scope made smaller before signing · a 
review date. Without these, a decision is only 
an announcement.

Why the order matters

A good deal with the smallest authority helps 
with the biggest one. It shows that the 
company can govern itself. So choosing 
which letter to answer first is already a 
decision.

THE HARD TRUT H

Refusing every offer is also a decision. The files stay open, and investors, buyers and 
licensors can see them.

A board that refuses must say what it gains. A board that signs must say who now runs 
operations: the company, or the agreement.

MOVE 4 有条件地决定 你的阅读会给你带来什么 AI 不可用 Slide 12c “有条件”是什么意思 不是“是的，但是……”。这意味着具体的计划： 修复，注明日期·检查，注明姓名 业主 · 签字前同意的措辞 · 签约前缩小范围·a 审查日期。

没有这些，决定就只是 一个公告。为什么顺序很重要 与最小的权威达成良好的协议会有所帮助 与最大的一个。这表明 公司可以自我管理。所以选择 首先回答哪个字母已经是 决定。残酷的事实 拒绝每一个提议也是一种决定。

文件保持开放状态，投资者、买家和 许可人可以看到它们。拒绝的董事会必须说明它获得了什么。签名的董事会必须说明现在由谁来执政 经营：公司，或协议。
pages.note: 有条件的决定不是一句“同意，但是”。它要写负责人、动作、截止时间、证明材料和重新评估点。

BLOCK B

AI OFF
Slide 13b

Regulation protects people

•
Every rule in Rello's week protects a real 
person: a rider who cannot afford to refuse 
a job, a grocer who cannot match prices 
below cost, the people living near a battery 
room, a person whose location is tracked —
and a neighbour who never chose Rello.

•
The rules come before the harm on 
purpose. If we wait for the lawsuit, we wait 
for the injury.

•
The authorities are doing the job the law 
gave them.

Regulation is a burden

•
Four sets of rules, four vocabularies, four 
deadlines. In practice, only companies that 
can pay for lawyers know them all.

•
Every rule is a fixed cost. A big company 
can absorb it. A start-up may not.

•
When nobody can know every rule, 
authorities choose whom to pursue. That is 
power.

• 规则先于危害 目的。如果我们等待诉讼，我们就等待 为了受伤。

• 当局正在依法行事 给了他们。

监管是一种负担 • 四套规则、四个词汇、四个 最后期限。在实践中，只有那些 可以花钱聘请认识他们的律师。

• 每条规则都是固定成本。一家大公司 可以吸收它。初创企业可能不会。

• 当没有人能够了解每条规则时， 当局选择追捕谁。那就是 权力。
pages.note: 从保护视角，监管提前防事故、纠正信息不对称、给弱势一方发声渠道。具体到本案，是骑手、客户和消防安全。

The founder is right: Rello harmed no customer.

Test each duty on its own, one document at a time.
